basics.name: Stéphane Rathgeber
basics.label: Tech Lead Symfony
basics.summary: A PHP developer since 2008 and a Symfony developer since version 1.3, I have worked with large companies such as Renault, Accor, My Money Bank, AXA, Cardif and Maif. I have mentored dozens of developers and helped them grow their skills. I can build an application from scratch or take over an existing one and keep it evolving. I can also set up continuous deployment.

work.name: Japan Experience
work.summary: Optimization of the customer journey in close collaboration with the Product Owner. Technical audit and analysis of the existing system, optimization recommendations and Symfony version upgrade. Technical support for the team: implementation of best practices, code reviews and developer skill development.

work.name: France Care
work.summary: Technical leadership of the project and implementation of a complete patient follow-up back-office, GDPR and HDS compliant. Fractional CTO role, with business challenge work: needs framing, technical trade-offs, prioritization and team support. Integrations delivered: Eloquant for call tracking and history, HubSpot and Yousign for case management and signatures, Stripe for patient subscription and billing. Led the infrastructure migration to Scalingo / Clever Cloud, audited and hardened application security (authentication), and set up a new subscription and payment portal. Focus on security, code quality, flow reliability and automation in a healthcare environment with strong regulatory constraints (HDS, ISO 27001).

work.name: GDB Consulting
work.summary: Design and development of a custom CRM for an energy broker (electricity / gas): management of clients, contacts and contracts (PDL/PCE delivery points), typed documents, segments and dashboard, with Excel import/export. In 2026, opening the CRM to AI: integration of an MCP connector with Claude, multi-supplier pricing and comparison work via API, and voice-assistant experimentation. Delivered through Kiora with autonomy over technical and architectural choices.

work.name: Digdeo
work.summary: Development of a technological monitoring solution aimed at mapping the entire Internet to identify website hosts. Architecture and implementation of infrastructure capable of handling massive data volumes (BigData) with Symfony, API Platform, RabbitMQ, MariaDB and Meilisearch. Continuous performance optimization to index and search billions of data in real time. Close collaboration with Kiora for project success, with autonomy in technical and architectural choices.

work.name: Safran Electronics & Defense
work.summary: Following the takeover of a back-office project at Safran Optronique, I was responsible for evolving an existing application while taking into account the challenges of very limited technical handover. My main role consisted of redefining the architecture and functionality of the tool, while ensuring security, a primary concern in this sector. Took over an existing project with little to no detailed knowledge transfer. Integration of improvements for better scalability and maintainability of the product, while ensuring regular updates without service interruption.

work.name: Brico Brico
work.summary: During my collaboration with Louis and his team, I was involved in various technical tasks to improve their Sylius project. Among the notable achievements, I managed the integration of Axeptio using Google Tag Manager (GTM) and Facebook Pixel to optimize consent management and user tracking. I also integrated several elements into their project, thus contributing to enriching and improving the user experience.

work.name: relevanC
work.summary: Application code audit with report writing and monitoring setup. API route optimization.

work.name: MeilleurTaux
work.summary: Building a subscription funnel for life insurance / PER.

work.name: Onatera
work.summary: Creation of a multilingual online sales platform. Adding client-specific features on Sylius.

work.name: Yousign
work.summary: Implementation of user tracking with Segment tool. Evolution on advanced signature, better error management, tracking improvements (email notifications).

work.name: Assoconnect
work.summary: Exposure of new resources on the existing API with legacy data synchronization. The goal being to migrate the project to an API / React structure and leave the legacy code.

work.name: ekWateur
work.summary: Implementation of API calls to a new REST WS for migration (with feature flag). Code quality audit. Implementation of quality control tools.

work.name: Dimension 4
work.summary: Implementation of two Web Service connectors, one in XML RPC and the other in REST. I developed a component and a Bundle for the second one.

work.name: Manymore
work.summary: Implementation of life insurance management act dematerialization solutions for AXA and Cardif. Creation of an extranet for contracts/clients and commissions visualization.

work.name: Orca Formation
work.summary: Creation of the sales and commission management application for Renault vehicles. Application used by the entire Renault France network. Credit/LOA simulator with rate management for My Money Bank.
